author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Why we should not review code anymore?

Here is an analogy, in the past, the old craftsman would inspect the work of his apprentices, to make sure the quality of his workshop is held up.

Now, it is like an assembly line in the factory, you don't inspect the work one piece at a time like the old craftsman anymore, you use machines and statistics to help you control the quality.
